scope: 2025 ICPC Shenyang A B C D F G I K L M
limitations: Independent small-case checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing. G verifies the overlap identity analytically and rectangle/triangle geometry numerically; F validates universal avoidance with exhaustive product-state reachability.

A.method: all kth pairwise differences for n<=15 and nine (a,b) settings, exact fractions

B.method: 1024 frequency/cost settings versus every ordered subset of solid-color layers and independent per-pixel choice

C.method: all nonconstant binary color partitions, messages, and m=2..9; exact three copies and modular decoding

D.method: 80 one/two-digit displays versus every repair subset up to budget and every displayable integer

F.method: all connected labeled graphs through five vertices and every starting pair; complete product-state reachability checks of constructed orientations

G.method: 625 rectangle pairs with independently integrated overlap formula plus official triangle sample

I.method: 20000 chronological records checked against full prior unique-solve history

K.method: 1000 random legal jump sequences and exact endpoint invariant

L.method: every legal four-state input through n=8, gate evaluation and <=6n node bound

M.method: 50 random seed/strength settings versus all 128 tournament outcome trees with exact rational probabilities, plus symmetric case
